title: Language membership via choice output
statement: Let $N$ be a finite-state nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over Boolean strings, and let $O,L$ be languages of Boolean words. Suppose $N$ decides $L$ with oracle $O$ within $T(n)=a(n^c+1)$ steps on every input of length $n$. Then for every Boolean word $x$, $x\in L$ if and only if there is a Boolean word $u$ of length $2a(|x|+1)^c$ for which the output assigned to $N$ on input $x$, oracle $O$, and choice sequence $u$ is exactly $[\mathrm{true}]$.
hypotheses_covered: finite-state nondeterministic oracle Turing machine over Booleans
